Sam (Finance): FYI the March invoice shows a -$9,600 marketplace credit applied at the billing-account level. It masked team chargebacks. Need plan to reclass.
Rina (Sales Ops): That was the promo I negotiated for ACME. Vendor applied it to our billing account instead of issuing a customer credit memo. They've opened a case.
Omar (Eng-Infra): If the credit is account-level "adjustment_type=promo" and labels are null, our chargeback pipeline drops it into "unassigned". We'll need to force a reallocation.
Tess (Platform): That will distort monthly budgets. Finance, do you want provisional internal reallocation while vendor fixes this?
Sam (Finance): Yes. Create a provisional journal to push the $9,600 back to teams by GPU-hour share for Mar 1-20. Mark it provisional pending vendor memo. Approvers: Sam, Rina, Tess.
VendorBot (cloud-vendor-bot): Vendor credit applied: vendor_id=vend-314, external_ref=VEND-ACME-CREDIT-01, amount=9600, case=VEND-3421.
Rina (Sales Ops): Vendor said they'll reissue as a customer-facing credit. ETA 5 business days. They also offered partial refund if we prefer cash.
Omar (Eng-Infra): I'll produce GPU-hour histogram for Mar1-20 and upload distribution CSV: drive.google.com/drive/folders/pm-gpu-chargebacks/marketplace-reclass-2026-03.csv. Also adding alert for marketplace credits >$1k without vendor_memo.
Tess (Platform): I'll open infra PR to require marketplace_memo meta on any external credit: github.com/redwood-inference/infra-ops/pull/812.
Sam (Finance): Finance will create journal JRN-2026-03-21-MKT and flag it provisional. Once vendor case resolves, we'll finalize or reverse. Attach vendor case id and distribution csv for audit.
Rina (Sales Ops): I'll chase VEND-3421 and update here.
Tess (Platform): We'll also draft a short runbook for handling marketplace credits so this doesn't obscure chargebacks next quarter.
Sam (Finance): Closing thread for now. Actions: Omar produce CSV, Finance create provisional journal, Rina follow vendor. Reopen if vendor changes stance.
